title: Try something new for 30 days
speaker: Matt Cutts

sentences.text: A few years ago, I felt like I was stuck in a rut.
sentences.translation: 几年前，我感觉自己的生活一成不变。

sentences.text: So I decided to follow in the footsteps of the great American philosopher, Morgan Spurlock,
sentences.translation: 于是我决定追随伟大的美国哲学家摩根·斯普尔洛克的脚步，

sentences.text: and try something new for 30 days.
sentences.translation: 用 30 天尝试一件新鲜事。

sentences.text: The idea is actually pretty simple.
sentences.translation: 这个想法其实非常简单。

sentences.text: Think about something you've always wanted to add to your life,
sentences.translation: 想一件你一直想加入自己生活的事，

sentences.text: and try it for the next 30 days.
sentences.translation: 然后在接下来的 30 天里去尝试。

sentences.text: It turns out 30 days is just about the right amount of time.
sentences.translation: 结果发现，30 天差不多正是合适的时长。

sentences.text: To add a new habit or subtract a habit from your life,
sentences.translation: 足以养成一个新习惯，或戒掉一个旧习惯，

sentences.text: like watching the news.
sentences.translation: 比如看新闻。

sentences.text: There are a few things I learned while doing these 30-day challenges.
sentences.translation: 在进行这些 30 天挑战的过程中，我学到了几件事。

sentences.text: The first was, instead of the months flying by, forgotten,
sentences.translation: 第一，与其让几个月一晃而过、毫无印象，

sentences.text: the time was much more memorable.
sentences.translation: 这段时光变得更令人难忘了。

sentences.text: This was part of a challenge I did to take a picture every day for a month.
sentences.translation: 这来自我“连续一个月每天拍一张照片”的挑战。

sentences.text: I remember exactly where I was and what I was doing that day.
sentences.translation: 我清楚地记得那天我在哪里、在做什么。

sentences.text: I also noticed that as I started to do more and harder 30-day challenges,
sentences.translation: 我还注意到，当我开始做更多、更难的 30 天挑战时，

sentences.text: my self-confidence grew.
sentences.translation: 我的自信心增强了。

sentences.text: I went from a desk-dwelling computer nerd
sentences.translation: 我从一个整天窝在桌前的电脑宅，

sentences.text: to the kind of guy who bikes to work — for fun.
sentences.translation: 变成了一个为了好玩而骑车上班的人。

sentences.text: Even last year, I ended up hiking up Mount Kilimanjaro,
sentences.translation: 就在去年，我甚至徒步登上了乞力马扎罗山，

sentences.text: the highest mountain in Africa.
sentences.translation: 那是非洲最高的山。

sentences.text: I would never have been that adventurous before I started my 30-day challenges.
sentences.translation: 在开始 30 天挑战之前，我绝不会这么有冒险精神。

sentences.text: I also figured out that if you really want something badly enough,
sentences.translation: 我还发现，如果你真的非常渴望一件事，

sentences.text: you can do anything for 30 days.
sentences.translation: 你可以在 30 天里做成任何事。

sentences.text: Have you ever wanted to write a novel?
sentences.translation: 你有没有想过写一本小说？

sentences.text: Every November, tens of thousands of people try to write their own 50,000-word novel,
sentences.translation: 每年十一月，成千上万的人尝试写自己的五万字小说，

sentences.text: from scratch, in 30 days.
sentences.translation: 在 30 天里从零开始。

sentences.text: It turns out, all you have to do is write 1,667 words a day for a month.
sentences.translation: 其实你要做的，只是一个月里每天写 1667 个字。

sentences.text: So I did.
sentences.translation: 于是我就这么做了。

sentences.text: By the way, the secret is not to go to sleep until you've written your words for the day.
sentences.translation: 顺便说一下，秘诀是当天没写完字数之前绝不睡觉。

sentences.text: You might be sleep-deprived, but you'll finish your novel.
sentences.translation: 你可能会睡眠不足，但你会完成你的小说。

sentences.text: Now is my book the next great American novel?
sentences.translation: 我的书是下一部伟大的美国小说吗？

sentences.text: No. I wrote it in a month. It's awful.
sentences.translation: 不是。我一个月写成的，写得糟透了。

sentences.text: But for the rest of my life, if I meet John Hodgman at a TED party,
sentences.translation: 但在往后的人生里，如果我在 TED 聚会上遇到某人，

sentences.text: I don't have to say, I'm a computer scientist.
sentences.translation: 我不必说，我是一名计算机科学家。

sentences.text: If I want to, I can say, I'm a novelist.
sentences.translation: 如果我愿意，我可以说，我是一名小说家。

sentences.text: So here's one last thing I'd like to mention.
sentences.translation: 最后我还想说一件事。

sentences.text: I learned that when I made small, sustainable changes, things I could keep doing,
sentences.translation: 我学到，当我做出微小而可持续、能够一直做下去的改变时，

sentences.text: they were more likely to stick.
sentences.translation: 它们更容易坚持下来。

sentences.text: There's nothing wrong with big, crazy challenges. They're a ton of fun.
sentences.translation: 疯狂的大挑战并没有错，它们非常有趣。

sentences.text: But they're less likely to stick.
sentences.translation: 但它们不太容易坚持下来。

sentences.text: When I gave up sugar for 30 days?
sentences.translation: 我戒糖 30 天的时候发生了什么？

sentences.text: Day 31, I looked like this.
sentences.translation: 到了第 31 天，我就变成了这副模样。

sentences.text: So here's my question to you: what are you waiting for?
sentences.translation: 所以我想问你们：你还在等什么？

sentences.text: I guarantee you the next 30 days are going to pass whether you like it or not.
sentences.translation: 我保证，无论你喜不喜欢，接下来的 30 天都会过去。

sentences.text: So why not think about something you have always wanted to try, and give it a shot for the next 30 days.
sentences.translation: 那么，何不想想你一直想尝试的事，在接下来的 30 天里试一试。

sentences.text: Thanks.
sentences.translation: 谢谢。

clips.summary: 几年前作者觉得生活一成不变，于是效仿摩根·斯普尔洛克，用 30 天尝试新事物。他发现 30 天足以养成或戒掉一个习惯；过程中时间变得更令人难忘，自信也随挑战增强——从电脑宅变得爱骑车上班，甚至登上了非洲最高峰乞力马扎罗山。

synonyms: try something new for a month

keyPoints.phrase: right amount of time to add or subtract a habit
synonyms: 30 days is the right amount of time

clips.summary: 作者指出只要渴望足够强烈，30 天可以做成任何事。他以写小说为例：每年十一月很多人尝试在 30 天内从零写出五万字小说，方法是每天写 1667 字、当天写完再睡觉。他自己一个月完成了小说，虽然写得很糟糕。

keyPoints.phrase: want something badly enough you can do anything for 30 days
write a 50,000-word novel from scratch in 30 days
synonyms: write a novel in a month
1667 words a day for a month

keyPoints.phrase: secret is not to go to sleep until you've written your words
wrote it in a month it's awful

clips.summary: 作者说在 TED 聚会上他可以自称小说家而不必只说自己是计算机科学家。他强调微小而可持续的改变比疯狂的大挑战更容易坚持（以戒糖 30 天为例），并提醒大家接下来的 30 天无论喜不喜欢都会过去，不必再等待。

keyPoints.phrase: I can say I'm a novelist
small sustainable changes more likely to stick
big crazy challenges less likely to stick
next 30 days will pass whether you like it or not
synonyms: whether you like it or not

clips.summary: 作者号召大家选一件一直想尝试的事，在接下来的 30 天里付诸行动，并向观众致谢结束演讲。

keyPoints.phrase: think about something you always wanted to try
give it a shot for the next 30 days
